# extract locations

Extract locations of sf objects.

## Usage

``` r
sf_coordinates(sfj)
```

## Arguments

- sfj:

  An `sf` object or can be converted to `sf` by
  [`sf::st_as_sf()`](https://r-spatial.github.io/sf/reference/st_as_sf.html).

## Value

A matrix.

## Examples

``` r
pts = sf::read_sf(system.file('extdata/pts.gpkg',package = 'sdsfun'))
sf_coordinates(pts)
```
